title: HIP LIFTS - BELLYDANCE ESSENTIALS 1 - learn how to dance with Coco Berlin

method.teacher_system: The teacher establishes a stable posture by bending knees and aligning joints, then isolates hip lifts through front and back leg movements, and finally layers in arm patterns and breathing awareness.
method.signature: Instructing learners to place hands directly on their hips to increase tactile feedback and internal body awareness.

practices.what: Place feet comfortably on the floor and bend knees front and back without locking joints.
Practice moving the hips as far as possible front and back continuously.
Place hands on hips to ensure movement stays parallel to the mirror and weight is centered.
Speed up the hip lift movement while keeping the upper body still.
Add basic arm patterns while continuing the hip lifts.

adaptations.difficulty: Standing too far apart feels weird and causes joint torsion
Upper body is moving along with the hips
adaptations.adjustment: Bend knees a bit more to relax the hip joint so it just hangs

beliefs.belief: Placing hands on your hip helps build feeling and awareness since most people lack good hip proprioception.

moments.says: The teacher welcomes the learner to the very first belly dance movement.
The teacher guides the learner to place their feet nicely on the floor and bend their knees.
The teacher asks the learner to check if they feel comfortable on the floor.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling encouraged to explore their own comfortable pace and bodily alignment.

struggles.theme: Feet and ankles get tense after a couple minutes
Looking ridiculous while learning the movements
Thighs feeling tired from the bent leg posture

clicked.theme: Starting with the knees makes it much easier to understand
Wearing fitted pants makes it easy to see knee bends
Clear step-by-step explanations without loud background music

requests.theme: Looking forward to step 2 of the lessons

meant.theme: Helped overcome shyness and fear of dancing in front of others
Inspiring for older beginners trying new things
Great daily workout routine for improving dance quality

method.limits: The video is filmed from a front-facing mirror view, so left/right orientation requires mental reversal by the learner.
